docs.title: Company Documentation
docs.text:
Welcome to the company documentation.

This is our central knowledge base for engineering, operations, product, and company processes.

docs.title: Engineering
docs.text: Technical documentation for software development, architecture, infrastructure, and deployment.

docs.title: Operations
docs.text: Operational procedures, incident response, monitoring, and support.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: This section describes the architecture of our systems.

docs.title: System architecture
docs.text: Our applications consist of several services communicating through defined APIs.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before deploying:

  • All tests must pass.
  • The release must be approved.
  • Production access must be available.

docs.title: Deployment procedure
docs.text:
1. Create a release.
  2. Start the deployment pipeline.
  3. Verify the deployment.
  4. Monitor the application.

docs.title: Rollback
docs.text: If a deployment causes problems, follow the rollback procedure.

docs.title: Development environment
docs.text: Instructions for setting up a local development environment.

docs.title: Git workflow
docs.text: All development work should be performed through Git branches and pull requests.

docs.title: Code review
docs.text: Changes should be reviewed before being merged into the main branch.
